summary: Parametrized no-click/Escape test uses a real tmp file and the unmocked unlink path: dismissal is proven by app.screen reverting to WorkflowsScreen (a stuck dialog fails isinstance; a missing dialog fails via NoMatches on the no-button or Escape popping WorkflowsScreen), and non-deletion by path.read_text(); the sibling yes-path test proves the same file genuinely gets deleted when confirmed.
